P0-1.name: D3 native model feature mismatch & manager-level exception swallowing
P0-1.root_cause: ModelRegistry.predict() hardcoded 4 harmonized features while model_d3_native.txt was trained on 73 native SCADA features. Furthermore, manager.py:247 contained an unhandled 'except Exception: y_pred.append(0)' block that fabricated benign predictions when models failed on missing features.
P0-1.remediation: Implemented model-specific feature routing with D3_NATIVE_FEATURES (73 features), strict schema validation, missing/extra column rejection, non-finite guards, and 73-feature SHAP explainability. In manager.py and onboard.py, removed exception swallowing, added explicit missing feature checks, and propagated HTTP 400 Bad Request with actionable diagnostic details.

P0-2.name: Adversarial SPA path traversal & header injection handling
P0-2.root_cause: serve_spa() fallback returned index.html with HTTP 200 for any non-existent path within document root, masking traversal sequences normalized by HTTP clients.
P0-2.remediation: Hardened serve_spa with raw ASGI scope inspection, multi-level URL unquoting to catch single- and double-encoded traversal (%252e%252e), backslash traversal rejection, null-byte rejection, document root containment enforcement, missing static asset rejection (404), and system directory blocklists.

P0-3.name: FastAPI application factory, lifecycle, and CORS isolation
P0-3.root_cause: FastAPI app was instantiated as a module-level global singleton at import time with development CORS regex, causing test fixtures using production settings to suffer from frozen middleware state bleed.
P0-3.remediation: Implemented create_app(settings=None) application factory, encapsulated middleware, router, and exception handler configuration, verified full ASGI lifespan startup and shutdown, retained backward-compatible module app singleton for Uvicorn, and isolated CORS tests to fresh application instances.
